description: This file defines the ModuleBuilderViewWizard class, which manages the display and processing of the module builder and studio interfaces in SuiteCRM. It handles rendering different views for module editing, layout customization, subpanels, search layouts, dashlets, and popups, including generating button configurations and navigation breadcrumbs.

classes.name: ModuleBuilderViewWizard
classes.description: A class that manages the wizard interface for module building and studio customization in SuiteCRM, including rendering views, generating button configurations, and handling user interactions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the wizard view, setting the view type and module based on request parameters.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns the module title parameters for display, including the module name and title.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the wizard interface, processing either ModuleBuilder or Studio views.

methods.name: processStudio
methods.description: Handles the logic for studio views, including layout, subpanel, search, dashlet, popup, and module editing pages.

methods.name: processMB
methods.description: Handles the logic for ModuleBuilder views, including search, subpanel, dashlet, popup, and layout views.

methods.name: generateStudioModuleButtons
methods.description: Generates buttons for available studio modules.

methods.name: generateMBViewButtons
methods.description: Generates buttons for editing different layouts and views within ModuleBuilder.

methods.name: generateStudioDashletButtons
methods.description: Generates buttons for studio dashlet layouts.

methods.name: generateStudioPopupButtons
methods.description: Generates buttons for studio popup layouts.

methods.name: generateMBSearchButtons
methods.description: Generates buttons for search layouts in ModuleBuilder.
